run_gen_build_yaml: run the script to generate YAML output for all LB interop test scenarios
generate_client_referred_to_backend: generate LB interop test configs for client referred to a single backend scenario
generate_client_referred_to_backend_mult: generate LB interop test configs for client referred to five backends scenario
generate_client_falls_back_because_no_ba: generate LB interop test configs for client fallback when no backends are available
server_sec: map a transport security type to its balancer, backend, and fallback security tuple
